content: The Grok adaptation service adopts a layered architecture where the pre-existing Codex-Bridge component handles all cross-cutting traffic governance (rate limiting, concurrency control, continuous runtime monitoring, forced cooling, automatic upstream circuit breaking, multi-line failover) and only exposes a local 127.0.0.1:8123/v1 endpoint for the adaptation layer, so the adaptation layer does not need to implement traffic control capabilities.
